qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for securing the wiper motor to the wiper bracket?
qa_pairs.answer: 7.5 Nm (ft. lbs.) using an M6 screw for E31LL/E38 models.

qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to the parked position stop to wiper console?
What is the torque specification for the wiper contact pressure motor to wiper console connection?
What screw size and torque are specified for the SWF wiper motor attachment?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 screw with 27 Nm (ft. lbs.) torque.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification applies to Bosch and Magnet Marelli wiper motors?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 screw torque specification (specific torque value not shown in the visible portion).

qa_pairs.question: How much torque should be applied to secure the wiper shaft nut to the body?
What is the torque specification for the holder to firewall attachment?
qa_pairs.answer: 10 Nm (ft. lbs.) using an M6 screw for E31 models.

qa_pairs.question: What torque should be used for screws in the firewall for E38/E39/E36 Coupe models?
Which models require 10 Nm torque for the E36/E31RL wiper motor attachment?
qa_pairs.answer: E36/E31RL models require 10 Nm (ft. lbs.) torque.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual contains these windshield wiper torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 61-4 General Electrical system, specifically subsection 61 61 Windshield Wipers.
